q: You give a colleague CAN MANAGE on a notebook that reads `prod.hr.employees`. They run it and get an insufficient privileges error. Why?
o: CAN MANAGE does not allow running cells
The notebook must be moved to their home folder
Workspace object permissions do not grant Unity Catalog privileges; they need USE CATALOG, USE SCHEMA and SELECT
Only the notebook owner can query tables
e: Object permissions decide what you can open or run. The query runs as the colleague, so their own Unity Catalog privileges are checked.

q: An on-call engineer must re-run and cancel runs of a Lakeflow Job, but must not change its settings or permissions. Which level fits?
o: CAN MANAGE RUN
CAN VIEW
CAN MANAGE
IS OWNER
e: CAN MANAGE RUN adds run now, cancel and run logs on top of CAN VIEW, without editing or changing permissions.

q: A dashboard is published with **Share data permissions**. A viewer has CAN VIEW on it but no grants on the underlying tables. What happens?
o: The viewer gets a permission error
The viewer sees the data, because queries run with the publisher's data permissions
The viewer sees only column names
The dashboard asks the viewer to request access
e: With shared data permissions, queries use the publisher's credentials (or a chosen service principal). That is why it should be used only for data every viewer may see.

q: Which compute access mode cannot read Unity Catalog tables?
o: Standard
Dedicated assigned to a user
Dedicated assigned to a group
No isolation shared
e: No isolation shared is a legacy mode without user isolation, and it has no Unity Catalog access. Use Standard or Dedicated.

q: You grant `finance-analysts` CAN RUN on the folder `/Workspace/Shared/finance`. What happens to a notebook created in that folder next week?
o: Nothing until you grant on the notebook too
It inherits CAN RUN for finance-analysts
It gets CAN MANAGE for finance-analysts
Only workspace admins can open it
e: Objects inherit the permissions of their folder, including objects created later. Grant on team folders, not on single notebooks.
